<cite ref="Sanhedrin 65b:11">Snh. 65ᵇ</cite> <he>מה גבר מגו׳</he> what is the difference between man and men (you and common people).

Gitt. 45ᵃ עדי ג׳ וכ׳ these (our captors) are men and those (our husbands) in Nehardea are men (Rashi: our masters, husbands), a. fr.
